policy.purpose: Regression corpus for detecting obvious contamination and output anomalies from small translation models.
policy.publicDataPolicy: Synthetic or minimal sanitized examples only; no full copyrighted chapters, user backups, or API keys.
policy.detectorPolicy: Corpus expectations are labels/specification; detector implementation begins in TQG-02.
policy.ambiguityPolicy: Cases labeled REVIEW are intended to exercise cautious detection and/or later AI inspection.
policy.foreignTextPolicy: Foreign text is not an error when it is a legitimate name, technical token, glossary-approved term, or otherwise explicitly justified.
